hindi: सन्धि आदि की निर्दिष्ट रीति के अनुसार न होने वाली स्थापना बुरी नीति है।
english: Placing treaties and the rest not as specified is bad policy.
notes: sandhi = treaty, apanaya = bad policy (glossary). ayathā-uddeśa-avasthāpana literally 'placing not as specified'; avasthāpana could also be 'establishing, employing'.

lines_iast: tasmād āpadaḥ sambhavanti

hindi: बाहरी उत्पत्ति और भीतरी प्रतिजाप; भीतरी उत्पत्ति और बाहरी प्रतिजाप; बाहरी उत्पत्ति और बाहरी प्रतिजाप; भीतरी उत्पत्ति और भीतरी प्रतिजाप — ये आपत्तियाँ हैं।
english: External origin and internal counter-instigation; internal origin and external counter-instigation; external origin and external counter-instigation; internal origin and internal counter-instigation: [such are] the adversities.
notes: pratijāpā ends in -ā (f. nom. sg.) while pratijāpa is normally masculine; read as the printed feminine, doubt noted. pratijāpa = counter-instigation (prati + japa, from √jap, as upajāpa = secret instigation). 'iti āpadaḥ' is rendered with a supplied copula only ('[such are]'); iti is not rendered 'thus'.
lines_deva: बाह्य.उत्पत्तिर् अभ्यन्तर.प्रतिजापा, अभ्यन्तर.उत्पत्तिर् बाह्य.प्रतिजापा, बाह्य.उत्पत्तिर् बाह्य.प्रतिजापा, अभ्यन्तर.उत्पत्तिर् अभ्यन्तर.प्रतिजापा - इत्य् आपदः
lines_iast: bāhya.utpattir abhyantara.pratijāpā, abhyantara.utpattir bāhya.pratijāpā, bāhya.utpattir bāhya.pratijāpā, abhyantara.utpattir abhyantara.pratijāpā - ity āpadaḥ

hindi: जहाँ बाहरी लोग भीतरी लोगों को उपजाप करते हैं, अथवा भीतरी लोग बाहरी लोगों को, वहाँ दोनों के योग में प्रतिजाप करने वाले की सिद्धि विशेष होती है।
english: Where the external ones instigate the internal ones, or the internal ones the external ones [instigate], there, in the combination of both, the success of the one who counter-instigates is superior.

text_flags.why: possible: the '.' compound mark joins a finite verb to abhyantara; the parallel 'abhyantarā vā bāhyān' and unit 17 'bāhyān upajapanti' show an accusative object (abhyantarān) is expected
possible: tatra is an adverb, not a compound member, so the first '.' should be the '-' of an unsandhied join (as in 'tatra-ekānta.yoga' in unit 17)

notes: anupajapanti = anu-upa-√jap; the sense of anu (afterwards / in turn / along) is uncertain, so it is not rendered separately. 'vā bāhyān' has no verb: '[instigate]' supplied in English. ubhaya-yoga rendered 'combination of both' (yoga here neither the 6.2 'acquisition' nor the Book 12 'contrivance'); the sense is uncertain. pratijapataḥ taken as gen. sg. of the present participle. Reviewer: the word is read upajapanti (abhyantarān upajapanti), not anu-upa-√jap, by parallel with unit 17; the first text_flag's suggestion should read 'abhyantarān upajapanti'. The second flag is sound: tatra is an adverb, so 'tatra-ubhaya-yoge' (or 'tatra ubhaya-yoge') is expected.
lines_deva: यत्र बाह्या अभ्यन्तर.अनुपजपन्ति, अभ्यन्तरा वा बाह्यान्, तत्र.उभय.योगे प्रतिजपतः सिद्धिर् विशेषवती
lines_iast: yatra bāhyā abhyantara.anupajapanti, abhyantarā vā bāhyān, tatra.ubhaya.yoge pratijapataḥ siddhir viśeṣavatī

hindi: क्योंकि प्रतिजाप करने वाले अच्छे बहानों वाले होते हैं, उपजाप करने वाले नहीं।
english: For counter-instigators have good pretexts, not instigators.
notes: vyāja = pretext (alternatives: guile, subterfuge), so suvyāja is rendered literally 'with good pretexts'; the exact sense is not certain. 'na-upajapitāraḥ' is the unsandhied join (print: na upajapitāraḥ / nopajapitāraḥ).
lines_deva: सुव्याजा हि प्रतिजपितारो भवन्ति, न-उपजपितारः
lines_iast: suvyājā hi pratijapitāro bhavanti, na-upajapitāraḥ

hindi: उनके शान्त हो जाने पर उपजाप करने वाले दूसरों को उपजाप करने में समर्थ नहीं हो सकते।
english: When those have been quieted, the instigators would not be able to instigate others.
notes: teṣu 'those' is ambiguous; it most likely refers to the counter-instigators of the previous units, but the text does not say. Loc. absolute.
lines_deva: तेषु प्रशान्तेषु न-अन्यान्-शक्नुयुर् उपजपितुम् उपजपितारः

hindi: क्योंकि बाहरी लोगों के लिए भीतरी लोगों का उपजाप कठिन होता है, अथवा उनके लिए दूसरों का।
english: For the internal ones are hard for the external ones to instigate, or [so are] the others for them.
notes: Elliptical. 'teṣām itare' read as 'the others (the external ones) for them (the internal ones)'; the genitive of agent with a verbal adjective makes the relation uncertain. kṛcchra-upajāpa = 'having difficult instigation'.
lines_deva: कृच्छ्र.उपजापा हि बाह्यानाम् अभ्यन्तरास् तेषाम् इतरे वा
lines_iast: kṛcchra.upajāpā hi bāhyānām abhyantarās teṣām itare vā

hindi: और शत्रुओं का वध बड़े प्रयत्न का होता है, तथा अपने लिए अर्थ का अनुबन्ध होता है।
english: And the killing of the enemies [is a matter] of great effort, and [there is] a connection with gain for oneself.
notes: The construction is loose. Alternative: 'mahataḥ prayatnasya vadhaḥ pareṣām' = 'the destruction of the enemies' great effort'. pareṣām = 'of others', i.e. enemies. anubandha = connection, continuation; artha-anubandha could also be 'continuing benefit'. The closing iti closes the reason clause and is not rendered.
lines_deva: महतश् च प्रयत्नस्य वधः परेषाम्, अर्थ.अनुबन्धश् च-आत्मन इति

hindi: गुप्तचर अथवा मित्र के वेश वाले गुप्तचर इन बाहरी लोगों के चर से कहें— “यह तुम्हारा राजा दूष्य के वेश वाले गुप्तचरों द्वारा छलना चाहता है, सावधान रहो।”
english: Secret agents, or agents in the guise of allies, should say to the spy of these external ones: "This king of yours wishes to outwit [you] by means of agents in the guise of the treasonable; be aware."
notes: The relation of bāhyānām, cāram and eṣām is uncertain: read 'to the spy of these external ones' (eṣām agreeing with bāhyānām); alternatively 'should tell these (eṣām) the spy of the externals', or cāra as 'movement'. atisandhātu is from ati-sam-√dhā ('outwit, deceive'); 'kāma' with the infinitive stem = 'wishing to'. dūṣya = the treasonable (glossary). The closing iti is not rendered.
lines_deva: सत्त्रिणो मित्र.व्यञ्जना वा बाह्यानां चारम् एषां ब्रूयुः "अयं वो राजा दूष्य.व्यञ्जनैर् अतिसन्धातु.कामः, बुध्यध्वम्" इति
lines_iast: sattriṇo mitra.vyañjanā vā bāhyānāṃ cāram eṣāṃ brūyuḥ "ayaṃ vo rājā dūṣya.vyañjanair atisandhātu.kāmaḥ, budhyadhvam" iti

english: Where the external ones instigate the external ones, or the internal ones the internal ones [instigate], there, in exclusive union, the success of the instigator is superior.

text_flags.why: possible: the parallel in unit 4 has 'ubhaya-yoge' (locative); the printed 'yoga u-' can also stand for yoge before a vowel, or be yogaḥ (nominative)

notes: 'yoga' is read as locative yoge by parallel with unit 4 (alternative: nominative yogaḥ, 'exclusive union: ...'). ekānta = exclusive, single; the sense of 'ekānta-yoga' is uncertain. 'abhyantarā vā' has no verb: '[instigate]' supplied in English. Reviewer: sandhi does not support the claim that 'yoga u-' stands for locative yoge (that would be yogay u-); 'yoga u-' fits yogaḥ + u. Reading as locative (by parallel with unit 4) is kept only as a literal guess; the nominative 'there is exclusive union (yogaḥ) of the instigator; success is superior' is equally possible. A person should decide; the text_flag stays open.

by regard for calamity and prosperity

hindi: शौच और सामर्थ्य के बहाने, अथवा व्यसन और अभ्युदय को देखकर प्रतिपूजन दान है।
english: Honouring in return, on the pretext of [his] purity and capability, or by regard for [his] calamity and prosperity, [is] gift.
notes: apadeśa = pretext (alternatives: mention, reference, ground). vyasana here = calamity of a person, not a vice. 'iti dānam' closes the definition; iti is not rendered as 'thus'.
lines_deva: शौच.सामर्थ्य.अपदेशेन व्यसन.अभ्युदय.अवेक्षणेन वा प्रतिपूजनम् इति दानम्
lines_iast: śauca.sāmarthya.apadeśena vyasana.abhyudaya.avekṣaṇena vā pratipūjanam iti dānam

words.gloss: agent in the guise of an ally

hindi: अथवा मित्र के वेश वाला गुप्तचर इनसे कहे— “राजा चित्त जानने के लिए तुम्हारी परीक्षा लेगा, वह उसे बताना चाहिए।”
english: Or an agent in the guise of an ally should say to these: "The king will put you to the test in order to know [your] mind; that is to be reported to him."

text_flags.why: possible: the opening quotation mark has no closing mark; the quote should close after ākhyātavyam, before iti

notes: upa-√dhā: 'put to the test, tempt' (cf. the technical upadhā); rendered 'put to the test', not certain. 'asya' ('of/to him') is ambiguous: the speaker, the king, or a third person; read as 'to him'. vaḥ is read as accusative 'you' here (it is genitive 'your' in other units). The closing iti is not rendered. Reviewer: vo may be genitive ('your king will test [you]'), as in units 13 and 21, instead of the accusative read here; the sense 'test' of upadhā-verb is kept literal but unconfirmed (glossary 13.4 keeps the noun upadhā untranslated). The text_flag for the unclosed quote is sound: close it after ākhyātavyam, before iti.
lines_deva: मित्र.व्यञ्जनो वा ब्रूयाद् एतान् "चित्त.ज्ञान.अर्थम् उपधास्यति वो राजा, तद् अस्य-आख्यातव्यम् इति
lines_iast: mitra.vyañjano vā brūyād etān "citta.jñāna.artham upadhāsyati vo rājā, tad asya-ākhyātavyam iti

hindi: अथवा इनमें परस्पर भेद कराए— “वह और वह तुम्हें राजा के विषय में इस प्रकार उपजाप करते हैं।” यह भेद है।
english: Or one should cause them to split from one another: "That one and that one instigate you thus regarding the king." [This is] dissension.
notes: The verb upajapati is singular with a double subject. 'rājani' is a locative ('regarding, in the case of the king'); 'against' is not stated. 'iti bhedaḥ' closes the definition and is not rendered 'thus'. parasparāt = 'from one another' (ablative of separation). The printed ' | ' (danda) is kept as its own token.
lines_deva: परस्पराद् वा भेदयेद् एनान् "असौ च-असौ च वो राजन्य् एवम् उपजपति" । इति भेदः
lines_iast: parasparād vā bhedayed enān "asau ca-asau ca vo rājany evam upajapati" | iti bhedaḥ

hindi: और दण्ड दाण्डकर्मिक की भाँति है।
english: And force [is] like the dāṇḍakarmika.
notes: dāṇḍakarmika is kept as a technical term without a guessed sense (presumably a rule or officer of the punishment procedure, not confirmed). daṇḍa here = force (the fourth upāya, glossary).
lines_deva: दाण्डकर्मिकवच् च दण्डः
lines_iast: dāṇḍakarmikavac ca daṇḍaḥ

hindi: इन चार आपत्तियों में पहले भीतरी आपत्ति को ही निपटाए।
english: Of these four adversities one should deal with the internal one first.
notes: sādhayet = 'accomplish, bring to success'; rendered 'deal with'. 'abhyantarām' agrees with an understood āpadam.
lines_deva: एतासां चतसृणाम् आपदाम् अभ्यन्तराम् एव पूर्वं साधयेत्
lines_iast: etāsāṃ catasṛṇām āpadām abhyantarām eva pūrvaṃ sādhayet

words.gloss: because of fear of a snake

hindi: साँप के भय से भीतरी कोप बाहरी कोप से अधिक बुरा है — यह पहले कहा गया है।
english: Because of fear of a snake, internal revolt is worse than external revolt: this was said earlier.
notes: ahi-bhayāt: ablative of cause, 'because of fear of a snake' (alternatively 'as with fear of a snake'). kopa = revolt (glossary 8.2).
lines_deva: अहि.भयाद् अभ्यन्तर.कोपो बाह्य.कोपात् पापीयान् इत्य् उक्तं पुरस्ताद्
lines_iast: ahi.bhayād abhyantara.kopo bāhya.kopāt pāpīyān ity uktaṃ purastād

words.gram: f. acc. sg. past part. ud-√sthā

hindi: आपत्तियों में प्रत्येक पूर्व आपत्ति को हल्की आपत्ति समझे, अथवा बलवानों से उत्पन्न आपत्ति को भारी, और विपरीत स्थिति में हल्की।
english: Among adversities one should regard each earlier adversity as the light one, or the one arisen from the powerful [as] heavy, and [as] light in the reverse case.
notes: 'pūrvāṃ pūrvām' is distributive (each earlier one, in the order of the four adversities of unit 3). 'vā' joins the second criterion; the phrase 'gurvīṃ laghvīṃ viparyaye' is read as 'heavy; light in the reverse case'. Elliptical; the verb is carried over from line a. Kangle-type reading, not verified.
lines_deva: पूर्वां पूर्वां विजानीयाल् लघ्वीम् आपदम् आपदाम्
उत्थितां बलवद्भ्यो वा गुर्वीं लघ्वीं विपर्यये
lines_iast: pūrvāṃ pūrvāṃ vijānīyāl laghvīm āpadam āpadām
utthitāṃ balavadbhyo vā gurvīṃ laghvīṃ viparyaye
